featured.label: Featured project
featured.title: The site went live. Customers called.
featured.blurb: They needed a website. MASAL Koltuk Yıkama works in Malatya, Turkey. We designed the whole site from start to finish, SEO and GEO first, carefully, with the latest tech. We opened the Google Business Profile and the Search Console profile and we still run them. 15 days ago this business had no website. Today it gets recommended first on Google search and on every AI platform, on every query with the same intent. After launch, people called. The firm found new customers. The MASAL Koltuk Yıkama website has already paid for itself.
outcomes: After launch they sit first on Google and on AI. The captures are still here
People found them on the site, on Google, and on AI, then they called. Work came in
The client who trusted us got that trust back the best way we can, and we will keep giving it back

steps.title: Discovery
body: We document the business goal, audience, available material, and technical constraints.
This stage determines whether the work calls for a website, an admin panel, CRM development, a chatbot, or a combined scope.

steps.title: Scope
body: Pages, features, priorities, responsibilities, and review criteria are written down.
The build begins after both sides understand what the project includes.

steps.title: Design
body: We establish the interface, component rules, and a CSS design system when the project needs one.
If the brand identity still needs definition, that work is resolved before interface production moves ahead.

steps.title: Development
body: We implement the approved interface and connect the required panels, CRM functions, or messaging tools.
Web and mobile surfaces follow the same agreed system when both are in scope.

steps.title: Quality review
body: We review mobile behavior, performance, core accessibility requirements, and technical SEO.
Primary actions such as contact, quote, and booking flows are tested from start to finish.

steps.title: Launch
body: The approved release goes live with the agreed support period and content handoff.
Later additions enter a separate scope so ownership, timing, and cost can be reviewed on their own.

about.label: Agency
about.p1: METEK Digital is a web design and software agency led by Nurullah Aydın. We build customer-facing websites and the admin panels, CRM interfaces, messaging tools, or mobile applications that support daily operations.
about.p2: We work within an established brand system when one exists. If core identity decisions are unresolved, we settle them before interface production.
about.highlight: The portfolio is the clearest way to judge our approach.
about.p3: Every project begins with the business model and the way people use the service. The resulting interface is designed for that context.
about.doIntro: A project can focus on one surface or connect several, depending on the operational need.
